0022600009.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-1, on a one-game losing streak, 4th in the Southwest and 10th in the West) host the Houston Rockets (1-0, on a one-game winning streak, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in the Spurs' second game of the 2026-27 season. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. The Rockets are also dealing with day-to-day, game-time decision absences to Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness), and the two teams have not met yet this season, though the Spurs won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat Houston 145-120 in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
